name: Avishkar
description: A plane of inspired invention, formerly known as Kaladesh, whose life depends on aether and which is now united under the Avishkar Assembly.

timeline.summary: The Consulate is overthrown in a popular, nearly bloodless revolution, and Kaladesh is reborn as Avishkar.
timeline.quote: The ruling Consulate has been overthrown in a popular, nearly bloodless revolution.

pages_say.description: The home plane of the Nalaars and the Varmas where the race ends.
A plane where Jace and Vraska did things to reach the Meditation Realm.
A plane ruled by the Consulate in the Echoverse and led by Pia in the normal version.
A plane of inspired invention, formerly known as Kaladesh, whose life depends on aether and which is now united under the Avishkar Assembly.
